g.title: long_island
g.text: Long Island detail and its neighboring connections
16 added buses / 22 shown | K backbone, J-K ties and East Hampton terminal
Blue square boxes: ADDED buses; gray rounded boxes: ORIGINAL buses. Labels = name / model ID / nominal kV.
Blue lines: added historical source circuits
Gray: retained; gray dotted: idle scaffold
xN = parallel branch count. Schematic, not geographic. Cross-voltage proxies are not certified physical transformers.
